caption: The drawing depicts a brass andiron, featuring an ornate, bulbous finial at the top of a tall, vertical post, which is supported by a curved structure with a decorative openwork pattern on the upper rail. The main vertical post has a series of rounded, segmented sections, some with spherical accents and a conical top piece. The lower section of the andiron extends into three outwardly curved legs, each ending in a rounded foot. To the left of the main colored drawing, there is a smaller, uncolored line drawing of the same andiron, shown from a front angle and with an added scale in inches below it. The main object is rendered in shades of yellow and gold to simulate brass, with shading to indicate form and depth. At the bottom right of the page, the name "JANET RIZA" appears in capital letters. The background is off-white, and the objects are outlined within a thin rectangular border.
title: Andiron
